name: qa-mobile
description: Mobile app testing: XCUITest and Espresso for native apps, Appium, Detox and Maestro across platforms, Flutter tests, and mobile accessibility checks. XCUITest also covers macOS desktop apps, and a tiered device matrix keeps CI cost down. An authoring agent (mobile-test-author) detects the driver, scaffolds a harness when none exists, and writes one test per spec. Mobile-web viewport emulation lives in qa-web-e2e.
